purpose: Teach: 一つ一つ/思いつい/ホラー/満点/秘訣/フィット/ネクタイ/香水

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さん、本気で、絶対、お料理、絶対、一つ一つ、絶対、丁寧にしたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Do you remember, Gran? When you were younger, your father — he was so serious about his cooking. Every single dish, he did it so carefully.
lines.style: Soft, slightly distant gaze into memory. Warm emphasis on 「本気で」 at the close. Patient pacing, as if he's checking that she remembers too. The voice of someone who lived alongside these moments.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、新しい商売、絶対、思いついた、絶対、わよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes, I do. When you were younger, Grandfather, you were so serious about your new business ideas. Every one of them, you'd come up with something and commit to it completely.
lines.style: Matching his pace but with a lighter touch. A small smile in the voice — not at him, with him. Fond correction, really. 「あなた」 at the end is a gentle needle, but the warmth holds steady underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、ホラー、絶対、映画、絶対、怖がったわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: You know, when you were young, Gran used to be terrified of horror movies. Absolutely terrified. Do you remember?
lines.style: Eyes twinkling slightly at the memory — there's something he's not saying but enjoying. Slight tease underneath the wistfulness. Measured delivery, letting the fact settle. The amusement of remembering her fear.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、テストで、絶対、満点、絶対、を、絶対、取ったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Oh, and Grandfather — you were so serious about your test scores. You got a perfect mark, didn't you? You never let me forget that one.
lines.style: A quick brightness through her voice — she's winning this round and knows it. Playful correction with an edge of real pride in him. The teasing of someone who knows where all the tender spots are and taps them with affection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、お料理の、絶対、秘訣、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、教えたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were younger, Gran taught your father all her cooking secrets. The real ones. Do you remember that?
lines.style: Quieter now, more deliberate. There's something precious in this memory — the knowledge passed down. He's not rushing. The voice settles, holding the weight of her expertise given freely to the next generation.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お洋服が、絶対、フィット、絶対、しないって、絶対、文句、絶対、言ったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes, but you were always complaining that your clothes didn't fit right. Every single time we'd go shopping, there you were — nothing fit the way you wanted.
lines.style: Warm laughter just at the edge of her voice, not breaking through. She's imitating his fussiness without meanness. The rhythm is playful, almost sing-song with the repetitions. A long-married couple's gentle roast.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、ネクタイ、絶対、結んでくれたわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: And when you were young, Gran used to tie your father's neckties for him every morning. Every single one. Do you remember how she'd do that?
lines.style: Voice softens considerably. There's something vulnerable underneath — he's remembering her hands, her attention to the small kindnesses. Not rushing the image. Slight trailing-off on the final question, as if he's already seeing it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、香水、絶対、苦手、絶対、だったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: And you were always so particular about perfume, weren't you? You couldn't stand strong scents. You made sure I knew it every single time.
lines.style: Her turn to gently needle. The delivery is warm but with a knowing edge — she's keeping score of his little quirks with affection. Rhythmic, almost playful. The intimacy of knowing someone's small dislikes by heart.
